# Notification

A notification sent to a person or organisation during estate administration — beneficiary notifications, executor appointments, probate grants, document requests

Source: [`v3/notification.json`](../../v3/notification.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/notification.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Unique identifier for this notification |
| `notificationType` | one of `beneficiary_notified`, `executor_appointed`, `probate_granted`, `asset_identified`, `asset_sold`, `document_request`, `other` or `string` | yes | The type of notification sent |
| `recipientType` | one of `person`, `organisation` | yes | Whether the recipient is a person or an organisation |
| `recipientId` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Reference to the Person.id or Organisation.id of the recipient |
| `recipientIdDisplay` | `string` | | Human-readable display name for the referenced recipient |
| `channel` | one of `email`, `post`, `phone`, `sms`, `in_app`, `other` | yes | The communication channel used |
| `sentAt` | `string` (date-time) | yes | When the notification was sent |
| `status` | one of `pending`, `sent`, `delivered`, `failed`, `bounced` | | Current delivery status |
| `templateId` | `string` | | Identifier of the notification template used |
| `notes` | `string` | | Additional notes about this notification |
| `provenance` | [Provenance](common/provenance.md) | | Consolidated provenance metadata — how this entity was created, by whom, and whether a human has verified it |

Also accepts properties whose names match `^x-inherit-[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,54}$`.
